introHtml: Pink oven mitts and pot holders make a bold, memorable statement for your brand in the kitchen. Whether you're outfitting a bakery staff or creating a giveaway for a breast cancer awareness event, the pink color adds visibility and personality. Our selection includes silicone-lined mitts for heat protection up to 500°F and quilted cotton pot holders that pair well with screen printing or embroidery. Choose pink to stand out in a sea of standard reds and blues.
